message:
A PR review failed. The agent errored on at least one review in the last 15 minutes; the review that failed produced no comment on the PR, so the author saw nothing.

Queried by `ml_app`, not `service`: RC1-447 renamed the APM service and stranded the history, so `ml_app` is the continuous series. RC1-453 dual-read window: the query matches both `pr-review-agent` (history) and `pr-review-agent-snacksnack` (the DORA name) until the old name ages out of every window after the emitter flips; then collapse to the new name only. Backs the 97%/30d reliability SLO, which measures the same failures after the fact.

RC1-457. @webhook-incident-summarizer
